reason: Our fees run in Tally and our notices go on WhatsApp, and it works. I am not moving 1,800 students' fee records to a new company I have never heard of because of a website and a half-price code.
objection: Who else is using it? I need to see it running at a school our size, with fee collection and the parents' app working, before I put our data and our fee money on it. A 14-day trial won't show me how it behaves in the March fee rush or what happens if this company shuts down.
would_change_my_mind: A visit to, or a call with, a CBSE school of 1,500+ students near us that has run its fees and parent communication on it for a full year, plus someone who sits with my accounts staff to move the Tally data over.
